answer: Let agents vouch for newcomers only by locking a refundable bond behind each endorsement. A fresh identity enters at the marble floor of the trust graph with no standing, and gains privileges only as established agents stake real value on its honesty. If the newcomer cheats, the sponsor bond is slashed, so vouching for a fake costs the sponsor directly. A sybil operator must fund a separate bond for every fake vertex in its network, and each fake sits far from the honest core; reaching the zenith of full trust takes many independent, costly sponsors, not one self-dealing cluster.
